name: Chas. Shaffer
role: Former partner in Shaffer & Munroe, Plum Grove ranch
bio: Chas. Shaffer was a partner with John Munroe in Shaffer & Munroe, of the Plum Grove ranch on the Little Missouri. The partnership was dissolved by mutual consent on May 24, 1884, a notice the Cow Boy ran through June.
